title_sq: Te Kodra E Diellit,Shitet Vile Kater Kateshe Me Lokacion Perfekt!!
description_sq: Ne zonen e Kodres Se Diellit, prane Big Market, Shitet nje Vile 4 Kateshe. Vila shtrihet ne truall 330 m² me gjurme ndertimi 103 m², duke e bere siperfaqen e banimit ne total 499 m² pasi katet mbi te parin zgjerohen dhe vijne me nje hapesire prej 132 m2 ,te pajisur me certifikate pronesie. Ne katin e pare organizohet ne dy hapesira garzoniere secila me hyrje vecante aktualisht te dhena me qira, duke filluar me katet lart me shkalle te jashtme secili kat i organizuar si apartament 2+1 + 3 ballkone,me planimetri te njejta, te arreduar dhe po ashtu te dhena me qira.Perpara vila disponon dhe nje oborr qe sherben nje pjese per parkimin e makines si dhe nje pjese per lulishte,kend relaksi.Aksesohet shume lehte nga rruga kyesore dhe eshte shume prane unazes. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: In the Hill of the Sun, a four-story villa for sale with a perfect location!!
description_en: In the area of ​​Kodre Se Diellit, near Big Market, a 4-storey villa is for sale. The villa is spread over a plot of 330 m² with a building footprint of 103 m², making the living area a total of 499 m² as the floors above the first are expanded and come with a space of 132 m2, equipped with ownership certificates. On the first floor, it is organized into two studio spaces, each with a separate entrance, currently rented, starting with the upper floors with external stairs, each floor organized as an apartment 2 + 1 + 3 balconies, with the same floor plan, furnished and also rented. In front of the villa, there is also a yard that serves a part for parking the car and a part for flower beds, a relaxation area. It is very easily accessed from the main road and is very close to the ring road. The property has full mortgage documentation.
